시편-93-1.title: 시편 93장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-93-1.exegesis: 15. and they thus declare God's glory as their strong and righteous ruler.
시편-93-1.theologicalNote: 15. and they thus declare God's glory as their strong and righteous ruler.

시편-93-2.title: 시편 93장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-93-2.exegesis: PSALM 93 Psa 93:1-5 . This and the six following Psalms were applied by the Jews to the times of the Messiah. The theme is God's supremacy in creation and providence. 1. God is described as a King entering on His reign, and, for robes of royalty, investing Himself with the glorious attributes of His nature. The result of His thus reigning is the durability of the world.
